A mercenary who stands firm and fearless on the battlefield.
A legendary figure who once held the #1 spot on the galactic mercenary ranking board, having achieved a 100% survival rate while exclusively taking on assignments with 100% mortality rates. Currently searching for a huge energy source for undisclosed reasons.
